say:4:1821426004:1.text: Here's the plan. I'll change course and <style="highlight">take the Tempest slowly into the reefs</style>, where we'll be forced to stop. I'll stay here and keep Loyd occupied.

say:10:1821426009:1.text: Marl's ghost suddenly begins to convulse. He claws at his neck, choking out broken gasps as though an invisible rope were tightening around his throat.
say:10:1821426009:1.source_cn: 忽然，马普尔的幽灵剧烈颤抖起来，他捂住自己的脖子，艰难...

say:11:1821426010:1.text: After a few desperate seconds, his ghost turns pale and transparent before fading away. The upper deck returns to normal.
say:11:1821426010:1.source_cn: 他的挣扎只持续了短短几秒，幽灵身影变得稀薄、透明，最终...

say:12:1821426011:1.text: A body now hangs in the shadow of the mainmast.
say:12:1821426011:1.source_cn: 而主桅杆的阴影下，一具高悬的尸体骤现。
